issues.legal_issue: A private criminal complaint alleging forgery or use of a forged document is not barred merely because the original document is produced in a court proceeding after the criminal court has taken cognizance.
material_facts: A private complaint alleged offences involving a fabricated agreement and its use.
The Magistrate took cognizance before the original agreement was produced in the civil proceeding.
The original agreement was produced in the civil proceeding after cognizance had been taken.
issues.conclusion: The later production of the original agreement did not invalidate the cognizance already taken, and the Magistrate could proceed with the criminal trial.
issues.legal_principle: Section 195(1)(b)(ii) of the Code of Criminal Procedure bars cognizance of the specified forgery and use-of-forged-document offences when the original document in question has been produced or given in evidence in a court proceeding; production of only a copy does not attract the bar. Later production of the original does not set aside cognizance already taken. The court relied on Sections 195 and 340 of the Code, and on Budhu Ram v. State of Rajasthan, Patel Laljibhai and Somabhai v. State of Gujarat, Sushil Kumar v. State of Haryana, Sanmukhsingh v. The King, and Gopal Krishna Menon v. D. Raja Reddy, distinguishing the last where the original documents had been produced before cognizance.

predicates.private_complaint_for_document_forgery_o: A private complainant initiates a criminal case alleging forgery of a document or use of a forged document.
predicates.cognizance_taken_before_original_produce: The criminal court takes cognizance before the original document is produced or given in evidence in a court proceeding.
predicates.original_later_produced_in_court: The original document is produced or given in evidence in a court proceeding after the criminal court has taken cognizance.

issues.definition: When a private document-forgery complaint is taken up before the original is produced in court, and the original is produced only afterward, the criminal trial may proceed.
